---
title: "Price volatility"
subtitle: "How much prices move within the day and between markets"
---

::: {.callout-note}
## Coming in November 2026
This page will measure how volatile Türkiye's electricity prices are, from the same hourly data as the [prices](prices.qmd) page.
:::

## What this page will show

- **Daily price spread:** the gap between the highest and lowest hourly PTF of each day. It is a first estimate of what a battery could earn from one charge and discharge per day.
- **Volatility within the day:** how far hourly prices move around the daily average.
- **Balancing versus day-ahead:** the gap between SMF and PTF, split by whether the system was short or long. It shows what it costs to be out of balance.
- **Hours at the limits:** how many hours each month the price sat at the cap or at zero.
- **Intraday market (GİP):** the spread of intraday trade prices around their volume-weighted median for each contract, a measure of how much a perfectly informed trader could have earned. This needs the intraday trade data, which is added later.
